fields.title: Mercury
fields.desc: Mercury is the smallest planet in the Solar System and the closest to the Sun. It has no atmosphere and experiences extreme temperature fluctuations.

fields.title: Venus
fields.desc: Venus is the second planet from the Sun and is often called Earth's twin due to its similar size. Its thick atmosphere traps heat, making it the hottest planet.

fields.title: Earth
fields.desc: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only known planet to support life. It has a balanced atmosphere and liquid water covering 71% of its surface.

fields.title: Mars
fields.desc: Mars, the fourth planet from the Sun, is known as the Red Planet due to its iron-rich surface. It has the largest volcano in the Solar System, Olympus Mons.

fields.title: Jupiter
fields.desc: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System, with a massive atmosphere of hydrogen and helium. Its Great Red Spot is a giant storm persisting for centuries.

fields.title: Saturn
fields.desc: Saturn is famous for its stunning ring system made of ice and rock. It is the second-largest planet and has more than 80 moons.

fields.title: Uranus
fields.desc: Uranus is an ice giant with a pale blue color due to methane in its atmosphere. It rotates on its side, making its axis nearly parallel to the Sun.

fields.title: Neptune
fields.desc: Neptune, the farthest planet from the Sun, is known for its intense blue color and supersonic winds. It has 14 known moons, including Triton.
